description: Climate-driven price pressure outlook for a commodity. Returns BULLISH/BEARISH/NEUTRAL signal with 30/60/90-day horizons, confidence score, per-region stressor breakdown, and current FRED price reference. Covers 11 commodities: WHEAT, CORN, SOYB, COFFEE, COCOA, COTTON, SUGAR, WTI, NG, COPPER, LUMBER. Designed for institutional research teams evaluating commodity positions. Signals reflect supply constraint risk from climate — not a financial recommendation. Cache: 4h.

fresh.description: true = bypass 4h cache and recompute live signals

name: forecast.commodity_outlook

climateScore.description: Supply constraint pressure 0–100; >65 = elevated bullish pressure

currentPrice.description: Latest FRED price reference (value, unit, date)

inGrowingSeason.description: true = stressors in peak transmission window — act faster

reasoning.description: Plain-language synthesis of climate signals and price implications

regions.description: Per production-region climate scores and drought/temperature readings

stressors.description: Active climate stressors with severity, region, price impact estimate, probability
